summary: Uninstall never settles the model's DONE job in the install store, so pruneTerminal's confirmedInstalled fast-exit cannot fire and the job survives the full 120s DONE_TTL. MpiModelManager's isBusy (MPI-241) then draws a 100% bar instead of the Install chip, and the store being main-process is why Ctrl+R does not clear it. Fix at the store, both engine legs.

Blast-radius sweep found 3 defects, not 1: the remote uninstall leg never calls reconcileOnce (engine-split half-wire), pruneTerminal cannot express confirmed-uninstalled, and the reconciler poll self-idles when no jobs are active so nothing ever prunes it. The stale DONE job is therefore permanent, not a 120s transient.

Shipped with 5 guard tests and a negative control (4 fail unfixed, 5/5 fixed); suite 298/298; eslint clean. Live attempt was VACUOUS - the store pruned the job 14s after install via the confirmedInstalled fast-exit, so the uninstall found nothing to drop. Repro recipe recorded: install, poll /comfy/downloads/status until the job reads complete AND IS STILL LISTED, then uninstall. Reproduces LOCALLY - no Pod needed.
Needs one local install-then-uninstall inside the window where the DONE job is still in the store.

LIVE-PROVEN on the local engine. Round 1 established the precondition the first attempt lacked (scripted poll fired the uninstall sub-millisecond after the job read complete while still listed) but was not attributable - a 15s reconciler tick could have pruned it via confirmedInstalled. Round 2 deleted the dep out of band first, so confirmedInstalled could never form: the immortal done job held 25s with the store version FROZEN (defect 3 seen live, not inferred) and vanished inside the uninstall POST with exactly one bump. No prune path existed, so store.dropModel is the only possible cause. Target nvidia-pid / vae-sd3, 168MB, single-owner and absent beforehand, so the disk ended exactly as it started.

validation.md now carries both live rounds verbatim (poll traces, the frozen store version, the backend trash+uninstall log lines) plus a reusable recipe for the next store-lifecycle bug: kill the competing explanation BEFORE acting, or a passing test is still vacuous.
Live proof landed; nothing outstanding. The remote leg's single confirmation is folded into the MPI-385 Pod-session brief.

Remote leg PASSED LIVE - MPI-385 item 6. klein-4b uninstalled on the volume through the Library; a 300ms poll of /comfy/downloads/status across the window shows NO job ever appeared and version did not churn - nothing to draw a 100% bar from. Reinstall clean: live progress 203MB/s off R2 in-datacentre, job complete, card moved instantly. Do-not-reopen condition never triggered.
mpi-cleanup: status "active" -> "done" on a card already in the done column (board-validator violation; no work state changed).
